queries: AGI achieved generative AI October 2026 independent verified

sources_considered.why: Primary independent evaluation addresses both substantial capability gains and why they do not establish AGI.
Search lead concerning a developer AGI claim; the benchmark owner's primary account was preferred.
Secondary tracker; not used in place of primary evaluation records.

evidence_items.explanation: ARC Prize reports major gains, including 99.9% with a provider-adapted harness, but expressly rejects treating benchmark saturation as proof of AGI. This is relevant progress against the prediction, without meeting the decisive-event rule.

unresolved_gaps: No independently validated demonstration meeting the broad AGI criterion was established by the search.
The speaker supplied neither a deadline nor an operational AGI threshold.
No generally applicable impossibility proof was identified.
